Datadog: :rotating_light: Monitor triggered: `kms.latency.p95` HIGH
Environment: prod
Scope: `service:control-plane region:us-east-1`
Current value: 1280ms (threshold: 600ms)

Sean Gallagher: anyone else getting spammed by the new KMS latency alert? we’ve had 6 pages in ~25 min. prod is fine-ish, but this is noisy during the wrapper rollout.

Allison Grant: yeah seeing it. it’s currently `p95 > 600ms for 5m` on *all* envs + all regions, which is… aggressive. also it’s not split by `env` in the pager route so staging spikes are waking people up.

Rafael Mendes: +1, KMS is bursty and p95 gets weird when QPS is low. we should gate on request volume or use p90 + min samples.

Nadia Rahman: looking at the dashboard: us-east-1 prod p95 is bouncing 400ms -> 1400ms but error rate is flat. seems like we’re catching transient latency + retries. there’s also a canary on 2% traffic with debug spans enabled.

Logan Wright: the instrumentation shipped last week tags `env`, `region`, `service`, `kms_provider`, `op` but the monitor query doesn’t include env and doesn’t filter staging. we can fix the query + add separate monitors per env.

Caleb Johnson: traces show 80% of the “slow” spans are `Decrypt` with a retry (first attempt timeout at ~250ms, second returns in ~700ms). our monitor is on end-to-end wrapper duration, so retries inflate p95.

Sean Gallagher: ok so two issues:
1) monitor routes are wrong (staging paging)
2) thresholds / evaluation window too sensitive for prod right now

Allison Grant: agreed. proposal:
- Split monitors by env: `prod` pages, `staging/dev` -> slack only
- Split prod monitors by region (us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1) but same pager policy; this reduces “global” noise + helps triage
- Add `min(request_count) >= 200/5m` (or whatever we can do in DD) so low-volume doesn’t trip p95
- Raise initial prod threshold to `p95 > 1500ms for 10m` while rollout is in progress, then tighten once stable

Tomáš Novák: also add a second condition for “real” incident: latency + error signal. e.g. page if `p95 > 1500ms` AND `error_rate > 1%` or `throttling > 0.5%`.

Rafael Mendes: careful with AND conditions — we’ve had KMS partial degradations where errors don’t show up but latency kills request SLOs. maybe two alerts:
- SEV3 page: sustained latency (`p95 > 1500ms for 15m`)
- SEV2 page: latency + elevated 5xx / decrypt failures

Connor O'Brien: fwiw rollout plan for wrapper is staged this week. we’re pushing to eu-west-1 tomorrow. would be great if alerts are sane before that.

Allison Grant: :thumbsup: can we do this as a fast monitor update + follow up with “proper” tuning after rollout? also I’d like to change the metric we alert on. alerting on wrapper duration includes retries; maybe we should have a metric for attempt latency (per attempt) + a metric for “total time including retries”.

Logan Wright: we already emit `redwood.kms.attempt_latency_ms` and `redwood.kms.total_latency_ms` in PR-18434, but the monitor is using `total_latency_ms`. we can switch the paging monitor to attempt latency and keep total on a dashboard.

Caleb Johnson: +1. paging on total can be misleading; it’s basically “how long did we spend retrying”, which is useful but not necessarily KMS provider latency.

Sean Gallagher: ok immediate actions:
- update monitor queries: `env:prod` only for paging, and add `region` dimension
- switch paging monitor to `attempt_latency_ms` p95
- extend evaluation window 5m -> 10m and raise threshold 600ms -> 1500ms (temporary)
- add a non-paging slack alert for staging + canary so we still see spikes

Allison Grant: for the split by region, let’s do 3 monitors for prod regions w/ the same notification template. message should include top tags: `region`, `service`, `op`, and link to the KMS dashboard panel filtered to that region.

Nadia Rahman: I can patch the dashboard links + confirm tag keys. also note: some services still tag `environment` not `env` (legacy). monitor should use `env` but we might want a fallback until everything migrated.

Logan Wright: ack. I’ll update the monitor to use `env` and add a note to fix legacy tag emission. we can also add a metric alias in DD but that’s slower.

Rafael Mendes: what do we want for warning thresholds? I’d like to keep a tighter slack-only warning: `attempt p95 > 800ms for 5m` so we catch it before paging.

Sean Gallagher: sounds good. prod:
- warning (slack): p95 > 800ms 5m
- page: p95 > 1500ms 10m + min samples

Tomáš Novák: :eyes: what’s “min samples”? DD has `require_full_window` + you can do `p95(last_10m):metric > X` but not sure about sample count. maybe use `avg:requests.count` as a second monitor? or just gate on `kms.calls`.

Allison Grant: DD supports “multi-alert” + “notify_no_data” controls. sample gating is awkward. simplest: page on p95 but only for services with meaningful volume (control-plane, data-plane). for low-volume, use p99 on a rolling 1h dashboard, not paging.

Sean Gallagher: ok scope the page monitors to `service in (control-plane, data-plane)` for now.

Datadog: Monitor recovered: `kms.latency.p95` HIGH
Environment: prod
Scope: `service:control-plane region:us-east-1`

Connor O'Brien: lol recovered again. please fix before tomorrow’s region rollout :)

Logan Wright: I’ll take the monitor changes. will post diff in #eng-sre once applied. target in next hour.

Nadia Rahman: I’ll update ENG-4828 with the tuning plan + add a note that we’re switching paging to attempt latency.

Allison Grant: also adding to the observability pack PR (pr-844) follow-up: ship separate dashboards per env, default view shouldn’t mix staging/prod.

Sean Gallagher: :thumbsup: thanks all. after changes land, let’s watch for 24h and then revisit thresholds (ideally align to an SLO / error budget).
